name: Rayzor Ranch Town Center
summary: Rayzor Ranch Town Center is a prominent lifestyle center located at the strategic intersection of I-35 and Highway 380 in Denton, Texas. This open-air development serves as a key retail and dining destination for the rapidly growing North Texas market, offering convenient access and a diverse tenant mix.
demographics: Rayzor Ranch Town Center attracts a diverse demographic mix from the rapidly growing Denton area, including young professionals, families, and University of North Texas students. The primary trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households with median household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $90,000, drawn from both Denton's established neighborhoods and the expanding northern Dallas-Fort Worth suburbs. The center's strategic location at I-35 and Highway 380 captures significant pass-by traffic from commuters and regional shoppers seeking convenient access to dining, retail, and services in one of North Texas's fastest-growing corridors.
description: Rayzor Ranch Town Center stands as a premier mixed-use development in the heart of Denton, Texas, strategically positioned at the hard corner of Interstate 35 and Highway 380. This vibrant lifestyle center serves as a central gathering place for the rapidly expanding North Texas community, offering a carefully curated mix of retail, dining, and entertainment options in an open-air setting. The center's prime location provides exceptional visibility and accessibility, making it a natural destination for both local residents and the thousands of daily commuters traveling through one of the region's most important transportation corridors. Developed and managed by FRP Ltd., Rayzor Ranch Town Center reflects the company's commitment to creating dynamic retail environments that enhance community life while delivering value to tenants and investors. The property's modern design and thoughtful tenant mix have established it as a cornerstone of Denton's retail landscape, contributing to the city's economic vitality and serving the needs of a diverse and growing population that includes families, young professionals, and students from the nearby University of North Texas.
